hebrewText: וְ/נִ֘עֵ֤ר פַּרְעֹ֣ה וְ/חֵיל֣/וֹ בְ/יַם ס֑וּף כִּ֖י לְ/עוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽ/וֹ

tokens.kjv: shake (off, out, self), overthrow, toss up and down.

tokens.bdb: Paroh, a general title of Egyptian kings
probably a force, whether of men, means or other resources; an army, wealth, virtue, valor, strength
tokens.kjv: able, activity, ([phrase]) army, band of men (soldiers), company, (great) forces, goods, host, might, power, riches, strength, strong, substance, train, ([phrase]) valiant(-ly), valour, virtuous(-ly), war, worthy(-ily).

tokens.bdb: a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south
tokens.enLiteralWord: a sea  or large body of water; specifically
tokens.explanation: yam — mar, lago, oceano, ocidente (o mar fica a oeste)
tokens.explanationEn: a sea  or large body of water; specifically

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
tokens.enLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanation: ki — conjunção causal e explicativa: porque, pois, que, quando
tokens.explanationEn: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed

tokens.bdb: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
tokens.kjv: alway(-s), ancient (time), any more, continuance, eternal, (for, (n-)) ever(-lasting, -more, of old), lasting, long (time), (of) old (time), perpetual, at any time, (beginning of the) world ([phrase] without end). Compare H5331 (נֶצַח), H5703 (עַד).

tokens.bdb: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
tokens.kjv: favour, good deed(-liness, -ness), kindly, (loving-) kindness, merciful (kindness), mercy, pity, reproach, wicked thing.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: kindness; by implication  piety; rarely  reproof
tokens.enLiteralWord: kindness; by implication  piety; rarely  reproof
tokens.explanation: kindness; by implication  piety; rarely  reproof
tokens.explanationEn: kindness; by implication  piety; rarely  reproof
